'''2007 Minnesota State Championship Sam Tashima LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Sam Tashima]] at [[2007 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' BMAC TRM
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
